overview: You kept the parish hour with the almanac open on the fifth and the sixth. Master Thwaite turned the glass twice. The margin beside Monday stayed empty. Three pews ahead, the Lord Mayor's back did not turn.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Sat the hour with the almanac on his knee and made no mark.

parties.name: Master Josias Thwaite
parties.context: Preached, and turned the sand-glass twice.

parties.name: Sir John Spencer
parties.context: Sat three pews ahead, turned away, and did not speak.

important_dates.meaning: The fifth, and an empty sixth
